// OP-03 Gate 0: native Google A/B test, ISOLATED STANDALONE SCRIPT ONLY.
// This file is generated from the exact candidate source. It must NOT be
// deployed to any live application, attached to production, or authorized to
// open production sheets. prepareTwoStageDrill self-creates all three workbooks.
// No pre-created workbooks, triggers, Script Properties or secrets are needed.
function prepareTwoStageDrill() { return op03NativeTwoStage_('prepare'); }
function expandTwoStageInventoryDrill() { return op03NativeTwoStage_('scale'); }
function captureTwoStageDrill() { return op03NativeTwoStage_('capture'); }
function verifyTwoStageDrill() { return op03NativeTwoStage_('verify'); }
function restoreTwoStageDrill() { return op03NativeTwoStage_('restore'); }

function op03NativeTwoStage_(phase) {
  var expectedScriptId = __SCRIPT_ID_JSON__;
  if (expectedScriptId === 'ISOLATED_SCRIPT_ID_REQUIRED' ||
      ScriptApp.getScriptId() !== expectedScriptId)
    throw new Error('Wrong isolated Apps Script project');
  if (SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet())
    throw new Error('A NEW standalone (not spreadsheet-bound) script is mandatory');

  var meta = __METADATA_JSON__;
  var fixture = __FIXTURE_JSON__;
  var clockStarted = Date.now();
  var nativeSheets = SpreadsheetApp, nativeProperties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  var stateKey = 'OP03_NATIVE_V3_STATE', propPrefix = 'OP03_NATIVE_V3_';
  var nativeLock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  var transitions = { prepare: '', scale: 'prepared', capture: 'prepared',
                      verify: 'captured', restore: 'verified' };
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(transitions, phase))
    throw new Error('Invalid isolated drill phase');

  var state;
  nativeLock.waitLock(30000);
  try {
    var raw = nativeProperties.getProperty(stateKey);
    state = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    if (phase === 'prepare') {
      // Inspect property NAMES only, never secret contents. A project that has
      // already been used cannot be co-opted as a fresh QA environment.
      if (state || nativeProperties.getKeys().length !== 0)
        throw new Error('A fresh empty standalone project is required');
      state = { tag: Utilities.getUuid(), phase: '', running: true, failed: false,
        ids: {}, scaleTabs: 0, expectedSourceHash: meta.sourceCodeSHA256,
        expectedHelperHash: meta.helperSHA256, expectedDrillHash: meta.drillDefinitionSHA256,
        day: Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'Asia/Jerusalem', 'yyyy-MM-dd') };
    } else {
      if (!state || state.running || state.failed ||
          state.phase !== transitions[phase] ||
          state.expectedSourceHash !== meta.sourceCodeSHA256 ||
          state.expectedHelperHash !== meta.helperSHA256 ||
          state.expectedDrillHash !== meta.drillDefinitionSHA256)
        throw new Error('Isolated phase, state or frozen source hash mismatch');
      state.running = true;
    }
    nativeProperties.setProperty(stateKey, JSON.stringify(state));
  } finally { nativeLock.releaseLock(); }

  var books = null;
  function bookName(role) {
    return 'OP03 TWO-STAGE SYNTHETIC ONLY ' + state.tag + ' ' + role;
  }
  function openBooks() {
    var seen = {}, found = {};
    ['source','backup','target'].forEach(function(role) {
      var id = state.ids[role];
      if (!id || seen[id]) throw new Error('Invalid isolated workbook inventory');
      seen[id] = true;
      var ss = nativeSheets.openById(id);
      if (ss.getName() !== bookName(role)) throw new Error('Wrong isolated workbook identity');
      found[role] = ss;
    });
    return found;
  }
  function saveState() { nativeProperties.setProperty(stateKey, JSON.stringify(state)); }
  function check(condition, reason) { if (!condition) throw new Error(reason); }
  function appendReport(result, detail) {
    if (!books || !books.backup) return;
    var report = books.backup.getSheetByName('_DrillReport');
    if (!report) throw new Error('Missing synthetic evidence sheet');
    var row = [new Date().toISOString(), phase, result, detail,
      meta.sourceCodeSHA256, meta.helperSHA256, meta.drillDefinitionSHA256,
      String(Date.now() - clockStarted)];
    report.getRange(report.getLastRow() + 1, 1, 1, row.length).setNumberFormat('@')
      .setValues([row.map(function(x) { return "'" + String(x); })]);
  }
  var currentBook;
  var sheetFacade = {
    getActiveSpreadsheet: function() { return currentBook; },
    openById: function(id) {
      for (var key in books)
        if (books[key].getId() === id) return books[key];
      throw new Error('Refusing workbook OUTSIDE this isolated test');
    },
    create: function() { throw new Error('Unexpected source-created workbook'); },
    flush: function() { nativeSheets.flush(); }
  };
  // The product code operates under namespaced, synthetic Script Properties.
  // Never expose or mutate the native production names from the product code.
  var propsFacade = { getScriptProperties: function() { return {
    getProperty: function(key) { return nativeProperties.getProperty(propPrefix + key); },
    setProperty: function(key,val) { nativeProperties.setProperty(propPrefix + key,String(val)); },
    deleteProperty: function(key) { nativeProperties.deleteProperty(propPrefix + key); }
  }; } };
  var mailFacade = { sendEmail: function() {
    throw new Error('Mail suppressed in native synthetic drill');
  } };

  try {
    if (phase === 'prepare') {
      books = {};
      ['source','backup','target'].forEach(function(role) {
        var ss = nativeSheets.create(bookName(role));
        state.ids[role] = ss.getId();
        books[role] = ss;
        saveState();
      });
      books.backup.getSheets()[0].setName('_DrillReport')
        .getRange(1,1,1,8).setValues([[
          'at','phase','result','detail','sourceSHA256','helperSHA256',
          'drillSHA256','durationMs'
        ]]);
    } else books = openBooks();
    currentBook = books.source;

    var result = (function(SpreadsheetApp, PropertiesService, MailApp) {
      // THESE are the verbatim production entrypoints and their exact
      // transitive dependencies; the three IO service facades are isolated.
__HELPERS__

      function revive(grid) {
        return grid.map(function(row) { return row.map(function(v) {
          return v && typeof v === 'object' && v.drillDate
            ? new Date(v.drillDate) : v;
        }); });
      }
      function seedSource(name, values, index) {
        var date = '2099-01-' + ('0' + (index + 1)).slice(-2);
        var created = _integrityWriteSnapshot(books.source,
          'outpatient-' + date, revive(values));
        created.setName(name);
      }
      function addSyntheticRows(sheetName, rows) {
        var sh = books.source.getSheetByName(sheetName);
        if (!sh) throw new Error('Missing synthetic source ' + sheetName);
        var head = sh.getRange(1,1,1,sh.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
        var start = sh.getLastRow() + 1;
        if (start + rows.length - 1 > sh.getMaxRows()) sh.insertRowsAfter(sh.getMaxRows(),
          start + rows.length - 1 - sh.getMaxRows());
        var values = rows.map(function(obj) {
          return head.map(function(key) { return obj[key] == null ? '' : obj[key]; });
        });
        // All generated IDs, dates, phone strings and currency samples are
        // literal values; never let formulas from a fixture execute.
        sh.getRange(start,1,values.length,head.length).setNumberFormat('@')
          .setValues(values.map(function(row) { return row.map(function(v) {
            return typeof v === 'string' && v ? "'" + v : v;
          }); }));
      }
      function assertSnapshot(h, suffix) {
        return !!books.backup.getSheetByName('outpatient-' + suffix + '-' + state.day);
      }
      function nativeReadback() {
        return _integrityValidateRestoreSet(books.backup, state.day, true);
      }

      if (phase === 'prepare') {
        var tabs = Object.keys(fixture.grids);
        if (tabs.length > 29) throw new Error('Unexpected source fixture count');
        tabs.forEach(function(name, index) { seedSource(name, fixture.grids[name], index); });
        // The initial Sheet1 is an opaque manual source and must survive.
        books.source.getSheetByName('Sheet1').getRange(1,1,2,1)
          .setNumberFormat('@').setValues([['manual'],['synthetic notes']]);
        seedSource('Copy of Clients', [['id','note'],['drill-archive','=literal']], tabs.length);
        var clientRows = [], leadRows = [], paymentRows = [], logRows = [];
        for (var i=0;i<300;i++) {
          var id = 'native-fixture-client-' + i;
          clientRows.push({id:id,name:'Synthetic person '+i,phone:'050'+('0000000'+i).slice(-7),
                           status:'פעיל',sessionsPerWeek:'1'});
          leadRows.push({id:'native-fixture-lead-'+i,name:'Synthetic lead '+i,
                         phone:'050'+('1000000'+i).slice(-7)});
          paymentRows.push({id:'pay::'+id+'::base::2026-11',clientId:id,
                            clientName:'Synthetic person '+i,status:'paid',amountPaid:300});
          logRows.push({sessionId:'native-fixture-session-'+i,clientId:id,
                       patientName:'Synthetic person '+i,phone:'050'+('0000000'+i).slice(-7),
                       billingType:'פרטני',outcome:'happened',date:'2026-11-01'});
        }
        addSyntheticRows('Clients',clientRows);
        addSyntheticRows('Leads',leadRows);
        addSyntheticRows('Payments',paymentRows);
        addSyntheticRows('SessionLog',logRows);
        return { phase: 'prepared', detail: 'Source with 300 typed synthetic records per core family and two opaque tabs' };
      }
      if (phase === 'scale') {
        // Optional but REQUIRED for realistic Gate 0 signoff. Repeated calls
        // add no more than 20 compact synthetic tabs to the backup workbook,
        // without touching source/patient data. The last 20 are old expired OUT
        // families that Phase B must prune after certification.
        var total = 350, n = Math.min(20,total-state.scaleTabs);
        for (var j=0;j<n;j++) {
          var index = state.scaleTabs + j;
          var name = index < 330
            ? 'dashboard-synthetic-' + ('000'+index).slice(-3)
            : 'outpatient-leads-2020-01-' + ('0'+(index-329)).slice(-2);
          var sh = books.backup.insertSheet(name);
          // Compact to avoid Google's 10M allocated-cell quota.
          if (sh.getMaxRows() > 2) sh.deleteRows(3,sh.getMaxRows()-2);
          if (sh.getMaxColumns() > 2) sh.deleteColumns(3,sh.getMaxColumns()-2);
          sh.getRange(1,1,2,2).setValues([['synthetic','only'],['source',String(index)]]);
        }
        state.scaleTabs += n;
        return { phase:'prepared', detail:'Synthetic destination inventory '+state.scaleTabs+'/350 compact tabs' };
      }
      if (phase === 'capture') {
        check(state.scaleTabs === 350, 'Run expandTwoStageInventoryDrill until 350/350 before time trial');
        var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
        props.setProperty('INTEGRITY_BACKUP_SSID', books.backup.getId());
        props.setProperty('FINANCIAL_OPS_CREATED','1');
        props.setProperty('INTEGRITY_TWO_STAGE_ENABLED','1');
        var before = Date.now();
        nightlyIntegrityJob(); // ACTUAL product Phase A, not a helper-only approximation
        var elapsed = Date.now()-before;
        check(!!props.getProperty('INTEGRITY_PENDING_BACKUP'), 'No pending marker after A');
        check(assertSnapshot(null,'pending-manifest'), 'Pending manifest absent after A');
        check(!assertSnapshot(null,'manifest') && !assertSnapshot(null,'verified'),
          'Phase A was incorrectly certified');
        check(!props.getProperty('INTEGRITY_LAST_COUNT'), 'Phase A advanced sentinel');
        check(elapsed < 300000, 'Phase A exceeded five-minute safety budget');
        return { phase:'captured',detail:'Actual Phase A '+elapsed+' ms; pending only; 350-tab synthetic destination' };
      }
      if (phase === 'verify') {
        var props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
        var before = Date.now();
        var finalized = finalizeNightlyIntegrityJob(); // ACTUAL product Phase B
        var elapsed = Date.now()-before;
        check(finalized && finalized.ok, 'Real finalizer refused');
        check(!props.getProperty('INTEGRITY_PENDING_BACKUP'), 'Finalizer failed to drain pending');
        check(assertSnapshot(null,'manifest') && assertSnapshot(null,'verified'),
          'Missing final manifest or certificate after B');
        var inventory = nativeReadback(); // second independent native readback
        check(inventory.some(function(item) { return item.source === 'Sheet1'; }) &&
              inventory.some(function(item) { return item.source === 'Copy of Clients'; }),
              'Opaque manual tabs not captured');
        check(inventory.some(function(item) { return item.source === 'FinancialOps' && !item.absent; }),
              'Financial journal missing');
        check(inventory.some(function(item) { return item.source === 'SessionLog' && !item.absent; }),
              'Session log missing');
        check(elapsed < 300000, 'Phase B exceeded five-minute safety budget');
        return {phase:'verified',detail:'Actual Phase B '+elapsed+' ms; certified '+inventory.length+' families'};
      }
      if (phase === 'restore') {
        var inventory = nativeReadback();
        var target = books.target, original = target.getSheets()[0];
        check(target.getSheets().length === 1 && original.getLastRow() === 0,
              'A fresh empty synthetic restore target is required');
        original.setName('__DrillEmptyTarget');
        var copied = [];
        inventory.forEach(function(item) {
          if (item.absent || item.source === '__RecoveryMetadata') return;
          var snap = books.backup.getSheetByName('outpatient-' + item.prefix + state.day);
          if (!snap) throw new Error('Missing exact snapshot ' + item.source);
          var targetSheet = snap.copyTo(target);
          targetSheet.setName(item.source);
          _integrityVerifyGrid(item.grid,targetSheet.getDataRange().getValues());
          copied.push(item.source);
        });
        target.deleteSheet(original);
        check(copied.indexOf('Sheet1') >= 0 &&
              copied.indexOf('Copy of Clients') >= 0, 'Manual tabs lost during physical copy');
        // Unknown sources deliberately block operational cutover until a
        // separately reviewed manual policy is pinned. Prove that refusal;
        // do not silently omit archives or forge a manual recovery approval.
        var refused=false;
        try { _integrityVerifyRecoveredWorkbook(books.backup,state.day,target,true); }
        catch(err) { refused=/Unclassified sheets require/.test(String(err)); }
        check(refused,'Operational restore MUST remain held for manual archive policy');
        return {phase:'restored_readback',
                detail:'Full native typed/opaque copy '+copied.length+
                  ' tables; manual-policy operational cutover deliberately refused'};
      }
      throw new Error('Unsupported Gate 0 stage');
    })(sheetFacade,propsFacade,mailFacade);

    state.phase = result.phase;
    appendReport('PASS',result.detail);
    saveState();
    Logger.log(JSON.stringify({
      phase:phase, result:'PASS', elapsedMs:Date.now()-clockStarted,
      sourceCodeSHA256:meta.sourceCodeSHA256, drillDefinitionSHA256:meta.drillDefinitionSHA256,
      syntheticWorkbookIds:state.ids, scaleTabs:state.scaleTabs,
      productionCertified:false, fullOperationalRecoveryCertified:false
    }));
    return {ok:true,stage:state.phase,scaleTabs:state.scaleTabs,
            durationMs:Date.now()-clockStarted,productionCertified:false};
  } catch(err) {
    state.failed = true;
    try { saveState(); appendReport('FAIL',String(err).slice(0,500)); }
    catch(reportError) { Logger.log('Gate 0 evidence append failed: '+String(reportError).slice(0,200)); }
    throw err;
  } finally {
    nativeLock.waitLock(30000);
    try { state.running=false; saveState(); }
    finally { nativeLock.releaseLock(); }
  }
}
